authorization_source: Standing user instruction to implement and validate the whole backlog; this disposition authorizes only reversible local validation needed to make the proposal concrete.
authorized_stage: First proof only: historical target/evidence closure, fresh/stale isolation, strict source-free export/import.
stop: Stop at the first proof or 60 minutes, whichever comes first; preserve evidence and request independent ATLAS verification. Do not continue broader changes on this disposition.
unresolved: historical closure and portable consistency feasibility
confidence validation obligation before broader execution
next_decision: Use actual proof and independent verification for an explicit further disposition; preserve the real confidence assessment and never claim human review occurred.

allocation.basis: Conservative allocation partition, not a claim about measured engineering effort already spent. No extension of the original five-day cap.
